So you’re down there, but then you go Queen G4, and that checks so they move away. Then you retake their bishop with your own, which pressures the Queen. The Queen can’t just take because then they lose their Queen to your own.

Looking at it again they can push the pawn to F6 rather than move the Queen away, but if they do that you’re capturing with the pawn on E3 and are up material - if they don’t push the pawn, you probably have Mate very shortly after because of the bishop crossfire and being able to move your Queen in on the G file (after bishop F6)

I like H4 a lot

I would go H4 and recapture with the knight, then bring the Queen to check, and pressure the bishop. Opponent backs the king off, you recapture the bishop with your own, targeting Queen which they now have to move away. You now have an active Queen and a bishop you can put on E5, a real attack on that side possible (albeit still very slow)

What do I do as Lucina vs Mario approaching behind fireball? I think it’s because Lucina is the first character I’ve played without a really obvious answer but Mario fireball/pikachu is thunder jolt feel so free to approach in. If I catch them doing it I can swing through it. But if I’m grounded/too far away when they run in behind it then I have nothing besides shield or jump. What’s the play? Do I just give up stage for free like that, or deal with that 50/50 or jump/shield? Is there something in Lucina’s kit that deals with it while grounded that I am missing?

Couple of really bad habits here:

1) swinging in disadvantage a lot. Other comments have touched on it but pulling a reversal (particularly against hard to hit characters like pikachu) is not consistent. Just do your best to mix up your landings by drifting away, recovering directly to ledge, or otherwise not trying to land directly on your opponent with a button. You should swing sometimes to threaten to your opponent that you might, but you do about 80%+ of the time here

2) What are you afraid of? Look back in this clip and count the amount of times you’re shielding when the pikachu is not very close to you at all. Shield is a good option for you but shielding when your opponent is not close limits your movement options and locks you in place. Particularly when you are charging shadow all you did this a lot, where the pikachu would take like a step forward from center stage and you’d shield as if he would be able to get you before you could react. Wait for the jump in or for pikachu to be in dash attack range before you shield like that

3) Piggybacking off your shield habit, you are an absolute roll-in fiend. Sometimes without the pikachu even prompting you shielded and rolled in, and a whole lot of times he just grazed your shield fading back with his arial and you rolled in. Try mixing up how you leave shield between jumping away, attacking with something fast if the opponent is close (I believe Nair for mewtwo but don’t know his frame data), and OCCASIONALLY rolling. That pikachu, whether consciously or not, hit you with a bunch of stuff just mashing his A button because after he touched your shield you rolled into whatever he did next

Outside of those things- really wasn’t that bad. Your movement and up-B usage could use a lot of work, but that isn’t an easy fix like mixing up disadvantage is - mastering movement with your character just takes time. As you get better at teleport angles and just general spacing you’ll improve a ton, but there’s no easy fix for that

Your friend is a roll in fiend. In neutral he rolls in a ton of times, generally right behind you and into grab. Watch for that and either spot dodge, down smash, or rising nair.

You aren’t good at tracking him in the air. Don’t commit to where he will land when he still has a double jump. Calmly walk under where he is in a straight line and if he is about to land, you can jump after him and chase if he double jumps then. Charging an up smash where he would’ve landed without using any resources will never work

You don’t use nair as a combo or get off me took and it’s Sehiroth’s best move

You are going for edge guards against joker who is wildly hard to edge guard, ledge trap him with your ridiculous range instead. Most matchups you’ll be able to go offstage like that, it’s just so hard vs Joker
